title: Test
script:
local WindUI=loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://github.com/Footagesus/WindUI/releases/latest/download/main.lua"))()
local Window=WindUI:CreateWindow({
Title="SoC Mod Menu",
Icon="monitor",
Author="PakooDev",
Folder="SoCFolder",
Size=UDim2.fromOffset(530,420),
Theme="Dark",
KeySystem={Key={"pakoo12"},Note="go get key",URL="https://discord.gg/F7bN6mwQn4",SaveKey=false}
})
local Section=Window:Section({Title="Main UI"})
local Tab1=Section:Tab({Title="Client Mods",Icon="monitor"})
Tab1:Button({Title="Walkspeed 100",Callback=function()game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed=100 end})
Tab1:Button({Title="JumpPower 150",Callback=function()game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.JumpPower=150 end})
Tab1:Toggle({Title="Infinite Jump",Value=false,Callback=function(state)_G.InfJump=state
game:GetService("UserInputService").JumpRequest:Connect(function()if _G.InfJump then
local h=game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")if h then h:ChangeState("Jumping")end end end)end})
Tab1:Input({Title="Custom Speed",Placeholder="Speed",Callback=function(v)local n=tonumber(v)if n then game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed=n end end})
Tab1:Input({Title="Custom Jump",Placeholder="JumpPower",Callback=function(v)local n=tonumber(v)if n then game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.JumpPower=n end end})
Tab1:Button({Title="Reset Char",Callback=function()game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:BreakJoints()end})

local Tab2=Section:Tab({Title="Server Tools",Icon="server"})
Tab2:Button({Title="Lag Fill",Callback=function()for i=1,2000 do local p=Instance.new("Part",workspace)p.Size=Vector3.new(1,1,1)p.Anchored=true p.Position=Vector3.new(math.random(-100,100),math.random(10,50),math.random(-100,100))end end})
Tab2:Button({Title="Crash Client",Callback=function()while true do game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Wait()end end})
Tab2:Toggle({Title="Auto Rejoin",Value=false,Callback=function(state)_G.AutoRejoin=state
while _G.AutoRejoin do wait(1)pcall(function()game:GetService("TeleportService"):Teleport(game.PlaceId)end)end end})
Tab2:Input({Title="Spam Parts",Placeholder="Amount",Callback=function(v)local n=tonumber(v)if n then for i=1,n do local p=Instance.new("Part",workspace)p.Size=Vector3.new(1,1,1)p.Anchored=true end end end})
Window:SelectTab(1)
